headline: Supreme Court Upholds Bombay HC Order on YES BANK AT1 Bonds
summary: India's Supreme Court left in place a ruling setting aside the ₹8,415 crore write-down of YES BANK AT1 bonds, with the bank assessing coupon payments and capital implications.
why: AT1 bond treatments directly impact bank Tier-1 regulatory capital adequacy ratios and subordinated debt pricing in India.

impacts.name: YES BANK Limited
impacts.why: Reinstatement of AT1 bonds creates balance-sheet liabilities and potential dilution to rebuild regulatory capital.
